chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn 'Imran al-Halabi, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muskan, from Zurarah, who said:

I was with Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, and with him was a man from the Ansar. A funeral passed by him, so the Ansari stood up, while Abu Ja'far عليه السلام did not stand. So I remained seated with him, and the Ansari continued standing until they had gone with it, then he sat down.
Then Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said to him: "What made you stand?" He said: "I saw al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام doing that."
So Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: "By Allah, al-Husayn did not do it, and no one from us, the Ahl al-Bayt, has ever stood at all."
The Ansari said: "You have made me doubtful, may Allah set you right; I had been thinking that I saw it."

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام, the speaker in the report
key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَكَّكْتَنِي: you caused me to become doubtful about what I thought I had seen

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say that the Ahl al-Bayt did not stand for a passing funeral?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام did not stand for a passing جنازة, and he rejected the claim that Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام or any of the Ahl al-Bayt had done so. The report is significant for discussions of funeral etiquette and the transmitted practice of the Ahl al-Bayt in legal and historical narration.
